context.transcript:
Thanks for listening to Radio 101, Ashton's local news station.
Tonight's featured story is the town's plan to renovate the
old railroad line that runs alongside Dorset Avenue. The line
has been out of service for over 40 years and the tracks
are now rusted. ® The line will be converted into a beautiful
walking path and new community garden. Several designs
have been proposed, and digital images are available on the
town's Web site. Residents are encouraged to view the
designs and vote on their favorite. ® Just keep in mind that
construction will begin in two months.
Steal

choices: The opening of a town library
The construction of a new bus station
The conversion of a railroad line
The demolition of a historic building
